original.reason: Step 3 is invalid: from g(p) dividing A(p) for each p, one cannot infer that the varying value g(p) divides the gcd of A(r) over all primes r. Thus constancy of g and the classification do not follow. Also the invoked infinitude of non-Wieferich primes is unsupported and unnecessary for the stated reduction.
